newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 closes down despite Komercni rise.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 closes down despite Komercni rise.

text.p: The Czech PX50 closed slightly lower on Tuesday as a powerful performance from Komercni Banka was outweighed by losses to three of the index's four most heavily capitalised shares.

After some strong rises in recent sessions SPT Telecom, as predicted by many analysts, dropped back, losing 30 crowns to 3,900. CEZ lost two crowns to 1,220 while Ceska Sporitelna fell by the same amount to 320.
Komercni Banka bucked the generally downward trend among the major issues with an 88 crown, 3.3 percent, rise to 2,788 which dealers said was led by GDR's in London.
"The price is copying the development of the GDR's (Global Depositary Receipts) in London. The standard discount is about 300 crowns," said Tomas Michalek of Raiffeissen Capital & Investment.
Komercni's GDR's were trading at the equivalant of around 3,500 in London throughout the day.
Generally, the bourse was moderately active on Wednesday, with turnover of one billion crowns and volume of 907,599 shares. Overall, 222 shares rose, 235 fell and 164 were unchanged.
